name: 75050 · Grand Prairie, TX
findings: ZIP 75050 (Grand Prairie) has 127 nonprofit organizations. 46 of them (36%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 37 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (39% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 75050 (Grand Prairie) has more organizations offering opportunities per resident.
28% of the organizations offering opportunities have no identified type, so the breakdown by type is partial.

observations.text: Per resident, more organizations in ZIP 75050 (Grand Prairie) list membership in their tax returns or on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 1.8 times the typical level).
